app.name: Oakridge Archers (archery club demo)
app.chooserSubtitle: New here? Take a quick look around the club site, or let us walk you through booking your first range session.

tours.title: Club site overview
tours.description: Disciplines, events, the leaderboard, membership and your member area.

steps.title: Welcome to Oakridge Archers
steps.body: This short tour shows you around the club website. Use the arrow keys or the buttons, and press Esc to leave at any time.

steps.title: Jump to any section
steps.body: Every part of the club site is on this one page. These links scroll straight to it.

steps.title: Range status
steps.body: Check whether the range is open, how many lanes are free and the wind before you set off.

steps.title: Four ways to shoot
steps.body: Switch between Target, Field, 3D and Barebow to see the rounds, distances and kit for each.

steps.title: Field archery
steps.body: We opened the Field tab for you. Field archery takes you round the woodland course behind the clubhouse.

steps.title: Start with a beginner's course
steps.body: Six weeks, all kit provided. Press Register to save your place. The bar shows how many places are left.

steps.title: Filter the leaderboard
steps.body: Narrow the table by bow type or search for an archer. We've switched it to Compound to show you.

steps.title: Top of the board
steps.body: The best score this season for the chosen bow, with its number of 10s and the archer's classification.

steps.title: Our most popular membership
steps.body: Adult membership gives unlimited range time and the indoor hall in winter. Use the toggle above to compare yearly prices.

steps.title: Questions answered
steps.body: Click any question to open it. This one explains what happens to sessions in bad weather.

steps.title: Your member area
steps.body: Members see their card, last scores and bookings here. Open it any time from Member area at the top.

steps.title: Replay any time
steps.body: Open Site tours to see this tour again, or to learn how to book a range session.

tours.title: Booking a range session
tours.description: Field by field through the booking form.

steps.title: Book from here
steps.body: Every booking starts with this button. You can also book from the member area.

steps.title: The booking form
steps.body: One short form. We'll go through it field by field.

steps.title: Your name
steps.body: Use the name on your membership, or your own name if you're booking a taster.

steps.title: Discipline
steps.body: Field and 3D sessions use the woodland course, so they have fewer slots.

steps.title: Date
steps.body: You can book up to four weeks ahead. Tomorrow is filled in for you.

steps.title: Time slot
steps.body: Sessions last two hours. The 18:00 slot is floodlit.

steps.title: Pick a lane
steps.body: Crossed-out lanes are taken. Click a free one to claim it. We've picked lane 3 for you.

steps.title: No kit? Hire it
steps.body: Tick this to borrow a bow, arrows, an arm guard and a finger tab for the session.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: Check the total and press Confirm booking. The booking then appears in your member area.
